title: Topic 17
japanese_text: 高校卒業後、３年ぶりに恩師に会いに行った。高校時代、先生は私が<u>非行</u>に走りそうになっていたことに<u>即座に</u>気づいて、止めてくれた。そんな先生は常に<u>情熱</u>を持って指導をしていて、多くの生徒に<u>慕われて</u>いた。
english_translation: Three years after graduating from high school, I went back to see my former teacher. During high school, he had noticed right away that I was on the verge of delinquent behavior and stopped me. He had such a passion for teaching, and was widely admired by his students.
